summary: apm prune --dry-run did not evaluate the gate retirement owner (install/exec_gate.py gate_retirements) for locked native plugins, so the preview reported nothing to prune while a real prune retired a revoked plugin; a gate evaluation error was reduced to a verbose line and prune kept the plugin. The dry run now lists each native root and declaration a real prune would remove, and a gate evaluation error stops prune with exit 1.
